Good to Know

Shipping

Orders usually get a shipping label within a day of payment. USPS Standard takes about 5–8 business days; Priority about 2–3.

Tracking by Email

You get your tracking number by email as soon as it ships. Check any time on Track Order with your order number and email.

Easy Payment

Pay by Venmo, Chime or PayPal after you order. Venmo fills in your order number for you so your payment is matched quickly.

Order Minimum

At least 2 vials or 1 kit per order, any mix of products. Pick Standard or Priority shipping at checkout.

Terms of service and purchase agreement

By placing an order you agree to all terms below. Please read carefully.

All Sales Are Final. No refunds, returns, or exchanges after payment is confirmed.

Pay as Friends. Send payment as a personal payment between friends (Venmo: Friends; PayPal: Friends and Family). A payment sent as a purchase, goods and services, or business payment is refunded minus the processor fees, and the order stays unpaid until you pay again the right way. Those fees are not returned.

Payment. Payment instructions and accepted methods are provided at checkout after you place your order. Include your order number in the payment memo. We confirm payment manually before shipping.

Single Vials and Kits. Products with a listed vial price may be ordered as single vials. Every order needs at least 2 vials or 1 kit (any mix of products). 10-packs / kits are available at the listed kit price. Kit-only listings cannot be ordered as singles.

BAC Water. Bacteriostatic water is an optional catalog item when listed — add it yourself if you want it. It is not included automatically.

Shipping and Lost Packages. Standard or Priority shipping per order, price shown at checkout. US addresses only. Carrier issues are the carrier's responsibility.

Legal Disclaimer. ALL products are strictly for research and educational purposes only. NOT for human or animal consumption.

Age Requirement. You must be 21+.
